items.q: What is TV PDF Viewer?
items.a: TV PDF Viewer is a Roku app for reading PDF documents on your TV using a remote-friendly interface.

items.q: How can I open PDFs on my Roku TV?
items.a: Open the Connect screen, scan the QR code or enter the shown address on a phone, tablet, or computer on the same Wi-Fi network, then choose the PDF files you want to view.

items.q: Do my device and Roku need to be on the same Wi-Fi network?
items.a: Yes. The phone, tablet, or computer you use to choose PDFs should be connected to the same local Wi-Fi network as your Roku device.

items.q: Can I choose more than one PDF?
items.a: Yes. You can select multiple PDF files, and folder selection may also be available on supported devices.

items.q: Can I view password-protected PDFs?
items.a: Yes. If a PDF requires a password, you can unlock it from the device you are using to choose the file.

items.q: Can I search inside PDFs?
items.a: Yes. The viewer includes PDF text search with result snippets and page numbers for supported documents.

items.q: Does the app remember where I stopped?
items.a: Yes. The viewer can reopen a PDF with the last viewed page and viewing settings such as zoom, fit mode, rotation, background color, and night mode.

items.q: Can I zoom, rotate, or change the reading view?
items.a: Yes. The options overlay includes zoom, fit mode, rotate, background color, night mode, search, thumbnails, and Go to Page.

items.q: Does Roku store my full PDF files?
items.a: TV PDF Viewer is designed for local viewing. The app keeps temporary viewing data for active documents and includes a Settings option to clear temporary storage.

items.q: Where can I manage subscription information?
items.a: The app includes a subscribe page and a manage subscription page with information about managing your subscription.
